id.description: The unique identifier for the card.

tagFields.description:
Tags associated with the card.
Renders in the bottom of the card.

supportTagField.description:
support Tag
renders on the top right corner of the card

supportTagIndicatorMapping.description:
The color of the support tag.
Specifies the color to display tags based on supportTagField value. The key is the data value, and the corresponding value is a color.

selectable.description: if the card is selectable or not
